item.title: Haley Stevens tops quarterly fundraising for open Senate seat, Rogers reports most in the bank
item.description: Rep. Haley Stevens (D-Birmingham) raised $2.1 million and has $3 million in the bank, while former Rep. Mike Rogers (R-White Lake Township) reported the most cash on hand with $3.45 million, as the four candidates compete for the open U.S. Senate seat in Michigan.
